description: One of the signed-in traveller's plans, day by day: each day's date, town and stops (with each stop's id, time, minutes, category, visitNote (what the traveller does there that day), note (the place's advisory), ticketsURL (its booking page) and, for a table, tour or ticket, booked (true held, false still to book)); a titleless freeform stop is marked role transfer, note or alternative), its bookings (with booked or still to book, and their details: a flight's airline, number, airports, terminals, seat and times; a hotel's address and check-in/out times; a train's operator and stations; a car rental's desks), and seq, the version to send back with edit_plan as base_seq. Needs sign-in.
name: get_plan
title: Get one of my plans
